info.name: BookSphere - Book Service
info.description:
Postman collection for Book Service (BS-BE-05).

Covers:
- Category API (CRUD + soft delete)
- Book API (CRUD + search/pagination/sort)
- Internal Saga API (stock decrease/increase)
- Via API Gateway (JWT) and Direct Service (role headers)
- Error branches (403, 404, 409, 422)

Prerequisites:
1. MySQL, Discovery Server, Config Server running
2. Auth Service, Book Service, API Gateway running
3. Run "00 - Auth Setup" folder first to obtain tokens
